versions.changelog:
blender-bpy-enhanced v2.2.0

- Added support for glass/ice material creation, with examples for refractive materials.
- Improved camera setup: now uses mathutils and quaternion-based look-at for more reliable orientation.
- Rendering now defaults to Cycles engine with GPU Metal acceleration support on macOS, plus built-in denoising.
- Expanded tags to include "3d-printing".
- Documentation and code patterns updated to reflect new material, rendering, and camera features.
- Internal meta and documentation files updated; obsolete files removed.
v2.0.0: Complete rewrite with procedural gear demo, metal materials, 3-point lighting, Eevee/Cycles render support, and common pitfalls guide. Enhanced from skillhub:blender-bpy v1.0.0
